material.description: Surface: js/client/feedback.js. Principle: WCAG 2.2 Contrast and Perceivability (DADA_WCAG, use of colour). All twelve marker overlays share one shape and size (feedback.js:11 MARKER_PX=28; feedback.js:42 ringCss(MARKER_PX, COLOUR.move)). The order kind is shown only by border colour (feedback.js:80 borderColor = move ? #4caf50 : #e53935). Symptom: for red-green colour-vision deficiency the green move marker and the red attack-move marker look alike, so the order type cannot be read. Witness: codesearch literal 'borderColor' (feedback.js:80) and 'MARKER_PX' (feedback.js:11,42). Fix direction, not applied: a distinct shape or glyph per kind.
material.subject: Move and attack-move order markers differ only by colour
material.witness: js/client/feedback.js:81 attack-move marker borderRadius 0px vs move 50% (live eval of pushed module at a5f84d56, verify-dada_wcag-trav-feedback-1). CI ci run 40112025824 success 3/3 (pages run superseded).
